name: Kurukshetra

queries.query: Kurukshetra Haryana official cadastral parcel map GIS land records portal
queries.result: First-party results identified the District Kurukshetra official directory, Haryana Web-HALRIS, the Haryana State GIS portal, and the Haryana Urban Local Bodies GIS viewer. The district and state systems document land-record/cadastral-map services, but no anonymous safe parcel-ID plus full-polygon response was exposed.

queries.query: कुरुक्षेत्र हरियाणा सरकारी भू-अभिलेख नक्शा GIS पार्सल
queries.result: The official Hindi District Kurukshetra information-system page exposes land-record links including Jamabandi and a cadastral-map viewer. It is evidence of a local district revenue/map custodian, but did not expose an anonymous safe parcel geometry response.

registryBasis: The official District Kurukshetra Hindi information-system page explicitly lists Jamabandi and cadastral-map services under land records, and the district directory links the official revenue/Jamabandi portal. This evidences a local district revenue/map custodian, not an open parcel API or legal-title dataset.

officialSources.observation: Official Hindi district page lists Jamabandi, HALRIS/HARIS, property registration, mutation, and cadastral-map services.
Official district directory identifies revenue/census services and links the Jamabandi portal.
Official Haryana IT page describes Web-HALRIS as integrated deed-registration and land-record management for all 143 tehsils, including Jamabandi, mutation, Khasra Girdawari and reports.
Official Urban Local Bodies GIS viewer describes mapped properties, ward/colony boundaries and municipal features; page requires department mobile/OTP login.
Official Haryana State GIS map page returned in discovery and exposes administrative/tehsil map controls; direct request failed TLS verification in this environment, so no data was extracted.

source.name: District Kurukshetra revenue and cadastral-map services
source.operator: District Administration Kurukshetra / Haryana Revenue and Disaster Management Department
source.method: First-party English/Hindi discovery and bounded anonymous GET/HTML/JavaScript inspection
source.responseFormat: HTML service directory and JavaScript-backed GIS viewer; no parcel feature response
source.scope: District/state land-record and cadastral-map service references; no verified open parcel-feature coverage for Kurukshetra city.

requests.outcome: Official directory returned; revenue/Jamabandi service links were visible.
Official Hindi page returned and explicitly listed cadastral maps, Jamabandi, HALRIS/HARIS and mutation services.
Official Web-HALRIS description returned; it documented land-record modules but no parcel geometry.

Current HTML and JavaScript inspected. The public page presents a department mobile/OTP login. Its JavaScript references https://gis.ulbharyana.gov.in/geoserver/DULBGIS/wms/ and POST /api/getRevenue; the latter response path renders owner, address, mobile and other unsafe fields, so it was not called.
Map route returned but no authenticated map data or safe parcel feature response was obtained.
Endpoint allows POST only; no POST was attempted because the inspected JavaScript showed unsafe owner/contact response fields.
WMS capabilities request was forbidden; no layer schema or geometry retained.
TLS certificate chain was not trusted by the default verifier. No certificate exception was authorized or used; no request data was retained.

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: Official Kurukshetra district revenue/cadastral-map references, Haryana Web-HALRIS, state GIS and urban GIS routes investigated.
coverageAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: Local cadastral-map service is evidenced by the district page, but no anonymous native parcel identity plus full polygon response was verified.

remainingUncertainty: The district page establishes service custody but not open API access, CRS, native parcel identity, city boundary coverage, or completeness. A login wall, forbidden WMS request, TLS verification failure, and skipped unsafe-field endpoint are not evidence of citywide parcel absence. Packet completion is not source integration or admission.
